tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search Salvage & Surplus product catalog.
Returns matching GPU rigs, server racks, drive arrays, and network gear.
Filter by category: compute, servers, storage, networking, support.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Retrieve full details for a Salvage & Surplus product by SKU.
Example SKUs: GR-001, GR-002, GR-003, GR-004, GR-005.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description:
Add a Salvage & Surplus product to your cart and receive a cart token.
Requires a valid SKU. Returns cart_token needed for checkout.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description:
Initiate checkout for a cart. Provide cart_token from add_to_cart and a billing email.
Returns a payment_token required to complete the purchase.

tools.name: confirm_payment
tools.description:
Confirm payment using a payment_token from checkout and a cc_token (credit card token).
Completes the Salvage & Surplus purchase and returns an order confirmation.
